title: Dhow Sailing
tagline: Ride the monsoon. Trim the lateen. Steer by the stars.
description: Captain a wooden dhow across the Indian Ocean in real 3D water: trim the lateen sail, steer by wind and star, dodge reefs and squalls, and trade between Kilwa, Aden, Calicut and Malacca.
howToPlay: Drag the compass to choose your course.
Drag the sheet slider until the sail is full.
Never point the bow into the red wedge.
At night, tap Sight and then NOW to fix your latitude.
Reef the sail when a squall comes.
